blocks.text: Managing multiple ad accounts in Chrome

Media buyers often manage dozens of client accounts. Using a single browser profile leads to session conflicts and login errors. Chrome profiles are the best way to keep your work organized. Click your profile icon in the top right corner of Chrome. Select Add to create a new profile for each client or project. This keeps your cookies and history separate. You will not have to log out of one account to check another.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for media buying

Speed matters when you are checking performance across multiple tabs. Use ⌘ + L to jump to the address bar. Use ⌘ + ⇧ + T to reopen a tab you closed by mistake. To navigate between open tabs, use ⌃ + Tab. If you want to jump to a specific tab, use ⌘ + 1 through ⌘ + 8. These small movements save minutes every hour when you are jumping between Ads Manager and your reporting dashboard.

Ad platforms are heavy. Sometimes the interface stops responding or metrics do not load. Do not clear your entire cache. You can clear data for just one site. Go to the address bar and click the settings icon or the lock icon. Select Site settings. Click View permissions and data stored across sites. Use the trash icon to remove cookies for that specific domain. Refresh the page to force a clean reload.

Lazur helps you stay in the flow while you work in Chrome. You do not need to hunt through menus for settings. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to find a specific setting or guide you through a task. If you are stuck on a complex report, ask Lazur to explain a metric.
Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask: How do I clear cookies for this site? Lazur will guide you to the correct menu path.
blocks.title: Quick help

blocks.text: Keep your browser lean. Too many extensions slow down your Mac. Use the Chrome Task Manager to see which tabs or extensions use the most memory. Press ⇧ + Esc inside Chrome to open it. If a tab is using 500MB of RAM, close it. Use bookmarks for your most visited ad account dashboards. Right click the bookmark bar to add folders for each client. This keeps your view clean.

You spend a large part of your day in email. Use Gmail labels to organize client threads. Create a label for each project. Drag emails into these labels to keep your inbox tidy. If you need to share access, use the delegation feature in Gmail settings. This allows your team to manage the mailbox without sharing passwords. This is safer and more efficient for small teams.

Researching new ad trends takes time. Use Lazur to run research in the background. Ask Lazur to summarize a long article or a document. This saves you from reading through pages of content to find one useful insight. You get a report while you continue to manage your active campaigns.

faq.question: How do I keep my ad accounts separate in Chrome?
faq.answer: Use Chrome profiles. Click the profile icon in the toolbar, select Add, and create a unique profile for each client account.

faq.question: Why does my ad manager dashboard run slowly?
faq.answer: It is often due to too many open tabs or memory-heavy extensions. Use the Chrome Task Manager with ⇧ + Esc to find and close the culprit.

faq.question: Can Lazur help me with ad platform settings?
faq.answer: Yes. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to point to a setting or explain how to navigate to a specific page within your ad manager.

faq.question: How do I clear site data without losing all my logins?
faq.answer: Click the lock icon in the address bar, go to Site settings, and delete data only for that specific site.
